entities.summary: The Treaty of Nettuno was an agreement made between the governments of Kingdom of Italy and the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes on 20 July 1925, which permitted Italians to freely immigrate into The Kingdom of Serbs, Croats, and Slovenes's coastal region of Dalmatia. Its ratification in The Kingdom of Serbs, Croats, and Slovenes's parliament took three years, as opposition Croatian Peasant Party representatives were infuriated with the treaty, calling it colonization by Benito Mussolini.
